headline: TI advertises AI/ML-assisted analog circuit creation and design-methodology adoption
fact: Texas Instruments posted Bengaluru role 25010677, Analog Circuit Design Engineer – AI/ML methodology. It assigns analog IC definition, modeling and schematic design, plus use of AI/ML-enabled tools and flows to accelerate development and create novel circuits. The engineer is also to drive adoption of those methods across product teams. Example circuit experience includes references, ADCs/DACs, amplifiers, oscillators and power-management blocks. This is a hiring mandate beyond device sizing alone; it does not demonstrate autonomous topology generation or measured design improvements.

sources.title: TI Careers: Analog Circuit Design Engineer – AI/ML methodology (25010677)
sources.summary: Official employer ATS description and Job Info display May 21, 2026. The duties explicitly connect AI/ML-enabled flows with novel circuit creation and product-team adoption; no topology-generation algorithm or achieved benefit is disclosed.
